feed.title: Luxury Content Strategist for Fashion
feed.description: ARVÉRO is a premium Made in Italy leather handbag brand focused on timeless design, exceptional craftsmanship, and international growth. We sell globally through Shopify and are building a long-term content strategy that supports both organic search and AI-powered search platforms. We are looking for an experienced Luxury Content Strategist who understands premium fashion, luxury ecommerce, and high-end consumer behavior. Preferred candidates are based in Europe, the UK, USA, Canada, or Australia or else whoever with knowledge in those specific markets Responsibilities You will own the strategic direction of our website content, including: * Review and improve all product pages to ensure they reflect a premium luxury brand. * Review and optimize collection pages for both customers and search engines. * Develop a consistent luxury brand voice across the website. * Create detailed content briefs for writers. * Build a content strategy that supports SEO, AI Search (GEO), and conversions. * Plan pillar pages, buying guides, comparison articles, and editorial content. * Ensure all content aligns with luxury fashion standards and premium customer expectations. * Recommend improvements to navigation, internal linking, and content architecture. * Work closely with our Technical SEO specialist and Shopify developer. Required Experience Please apply only if you have experience with one or more of the following: * Luxury fashion * Premium handbags * Leather goods * Luxury accessories * Premium footwear * Designer lifestyle brands Shopify ecommerce experience is highly preferred. Preferred Skills * Luxury brand positioning * Content strategy * Fashion copywriting * Premium ecommerce * Shopify * SEO * AI Search / GEO (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) * E-E-A-T * Search intent optimization * Editorial planning When Applying, Please Include Please provide: 1. Luxury or premium fashion brands you have worked with. 2. Website URLs. 3. Your exact role on each project. 4. Examples of product pages or collection pages you have improved. 5. Examples of content briefs or content strategies you have created. 6. Measurable results (traffic, rankings, conversions, revenue, engagement, etc.). 7. Explain how you would position a premium Italian leather handbag brand to compete with brands such as Polène, Strathberry, DeMellier, Furla, Coccinelle, and similar luxury brands. 8. Describe your experience optimizing content for both traditional SEO and AI-powered search (GEO). Ideal Candidate We’re looking for someone who understands that luxury content is about much more than keywords. You should know how to communicate craftsmanship, quality, heritage, and exclusivity while creating content that attracts qualified buyers and supports long-term organic growth. This is a long-term opportunity for the right person to help shape the voice and content strategy of a growing international luxury brand.

job.description:
ARVÉRO is a premium Made in Italy leather handbag brand focused on timeless design, exceptional craftsmanship, and international growth. We sell globally through Shopify and are building a long-term content strategy that supports both organic search and AI-powered search platforms.

We are looking for an experienced Luxury Content Strategist who understands premium fashion, luxury ecommerce, and high-end consumer behavior.

Preferred candidates are based in Europe, the UK, USA, Canada, or Australia or else whoever with knowledge in those specific markets 

Responsibilities

You will own the strategic direction of our website content, including:

* Review and improve all product pages to ensure they reflect a premium luxury brand.
* Review and optimize collection pages for both customers and search engines.
* Develop a consistent luxury brand voice across the website.
* Create detailed content briefs for writers.
* Build a content strategy that supports SEO, AI Search (GEO), and conversions.
* Plan pillar pages, buying guides, comparison articles, and editorial content.
* Ensure all content aligns with luxury fashion standards and premium customer expectations.
* Recommend improvements to navigation, internal linking, and content architecture.
* Work closely with our Technical SEO specialist and Shopify developer.

Required Experience

Please apply only if you have experience with one or more of the following:

* Luxury fashion
* Premium handbags
* Leather goods
* Luxury accessories
* Premium footwear
* Designer lifestyle brands

Shopify ecommerce experience is highly preferred.

Preferred Skills

* Luxury brand positioning
* Content strategy
* Fashion copywriting
* Premium ecommerce
* Shopify
* SEO
* AI Search / GEO (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini)
* E-E-A-T
* Search intent optimization
* Editorial planning

When Applying, Please Include

Please provide:

1. Luxury or premium fashion brands you have worked with.
2. Website URLs.
3. Your exact role on each project.
4. Examples of product pages or collection pages you have improved.
5. Examples of content briefs or content strategies you have created.
6. Measurable results (traffic, rankings, conversions, revenue, engagement, etc.).
7. Explain how you would position a premium Italian leather handbag brand to compete with brands such as Polène, Strathberry, DeMellier, Furla, Coccinelle, and similar luxury brands.
8. Describe your experience optimizing content for both traditional SEO and AI-powered search (GEO).

Ideal Candidate

We’re looking for someone who understands that luxury content is about much more than keywords. You should know how to communicate craftsmanship, quality, heritage, and exclusivity while creating content that attracts qualified buyers and supports long-term organic growth.

This is a long-term opportunity for the right person to help shape the voice and content strategy of a growing international luxury brand.
